subject: SOC 2 re-attest: log retention, evidence handoff, and renewal capacity ask
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acmecorp.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 re-attest: scope change + retention request

Hi Rishi,

Quick note as we begin our renewal planning: Acme is preparing for SOC 2 re-attestation and our compliance team has requested two changes that will impact the renewal terms and capacity needs:

- Retention: increase log/audit retention from 90 days to 365 days for access and inference logs (legal/regulatory ask).
- Evidence window: we expect to hand off bulk evidence (export of audit logs + config snapshots) during a 3-week window in July.

Separately, our product team expects a usage bump tied to an upcoming feature launch — we want pricing and timing for: +15 additional seats (from 10 to 25) and a dedicated burst capacity option (GPU pool for peak hours).

Can you confirm what artifacts Redwood needs for the re-attest, the timeline you recommend for evidence collection, and a ballpark for the capacity/term change? I attached our initial questions.

Thanks,

Sara Liu
Head of Security & Compliance
Acme Corp
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: acme_recert_questions.pdf

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acmecorp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attest: scope change + retention request

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and the attachment. Looping in Laura (security lead) and Grace (AM) + Karthik from compliance so we can align on evidence and commercials.

At a high level:
- Retention: we support configurable retention windows. Moving to 365 days is feasible; we do it as an add-on capacity (log-archive store + retrieval SLA). I flagged cost and egress impacts below.
- Evidence: for a smooth re-attest, we recommend a 3-week dedicated handoff window (snapshot exports + a staging folder in Google Drive). See the manifest template I attached — please fill in for the datasets you want included (access logs, inference traces, config snapshots, auth logs).
- Capacity/pricing: Grace will propose ring-fenced pricing for the +15 seats and a dedicated burst pool; options: monthly on-demand burst versus reserved monthly burst (discounted). For renewal terms (12 vs 24 months) there are incremental discounts for longer commitments.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Sara/Acme: fill the manifest template and confirm the July 5–23 evidence window (we can shift +/- 1 week).
2) Redwood (Laura + Karthik): produce an evidence checklist, retention SLA, and preliminary estimate for log-archive costs.
3) Redwood (Grace): send a draft renewal amendment (term/seat/capacity) and a DocuSign link for procurement.

I attached a manifest template to make the handoff easier.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Customer Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOC2_evidence_manifest_template.xlsx

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acmecorp.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attest: scope change + retention request

Sara — quick runbook from the security side. High level checklist and timelines below.

Required artifacts (minimum):
- Access logs (system auth events) covering requested attest window.
- Inference request/response traces (sampling is acceptable; we'll coordinate sampling fraction).
- Model config snapshots and deployment manifests.
- IAM role policy exports and admin activity logs.
- Evidence manifest + signed acceptance from your compliance PO.

Recommended timeline:
- Week 0 (kickoff): confirm manifest, credentials for staging Drive folder, and any redaction requirements.
- Weeks 1–2: automated exports + validation (we run schema checks and checksum).
- Week 3: bulk handoff, verification, and secure wipe of staging area.

Retention options:
- Option A (managed archive): 365-day retention in platform archive with 24h retrieval SLA.
- Option B (cold export): we provide an encrypted export package you store; retrieval is 3–5 business days.

Notes on cost and compliance impact: 365-day managed retention increases storage/egress and adds an operational monitoring fee. For SOC 2, we also recommend enabling write-once audit buckets (WORM) for the handoff period.

Attachments: log-retention-options.pdf, evidence-upload-playbook.md

If that looks good, Rishi/Grace — can you draft the formal amendment (scope, term, price) and I’ll sign off on the security appendices?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

From: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acmecorp.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attest: scope change + retention request

Hi Sara — thanks, all. Pricing and term options below (ballpark; will put formal numbers into HubSpot and DocuSign once you confirm):

Renewal term options:
- 12-month: base renewal + 15-seat add-on (pro rata) — standard onboarding fee waived.
- 24-month: 8% contract discount on platform fees + discounted dedicated burst reservation pricing.

Retention/Log archive pricing:
- Managed archive (365d): flat storage fee + retrieval SLA surcharge (we estimate ~$2,500/month for expected volume; final will depend on actual ingestion).
- Cold export: one-time export fee (lower monthly cost, higher retrieval lead time).

Dedicated burst capacity:
- On-demand burst (no commit): higher per-hour GPU rate; good if peaks are short and unpredictable.
- Reserved burst (monthly commit): ~25% lower hourly cost; recommended if you expect regular peak windows.

Next steps from procurement:
1) Confirm term (12 vs 24) and desired retention option.
2) I’ll push a draft amendment to HubSpot (HS-deal-87345) and generate a DocuSign for signature.
3) PO: please send vendor PO or procurement contact; we’ll assign billing and set an effective date that aligns with evidence window.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://docusign.com/link/placeholder-acme-renewal

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Account Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acmecorp.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attest: scope change + retention request

Thanks everyone — clear and helpful. We will proceed as follows:

- Term: 24-month renewal (preferred)
- Seats: increase to 25 total (add-on effective at renewal start)
- Retention: Option A (managed 365d archive) with 24h retrieval SLA; we accept the storage surcharge estimate pending final numbers.
- Capacity: request Reserved burst pool with monthly commit (Grace, please include the 25% reserved discount in the amendment).

Procurement contact attached (VCF). Please generate the amendment and DocuSign and we’ll have procurement review for a PO.

Sara Liu
Head of Security & Compliance
Acme Corp
Attachment: procurement_contact.vcf
